justification: The quoted intersection equality has a genuine defect distinct from adjoint injectivity. In the assessment’s quadratic example, choose basis vectors e1,e2 exchanged by τ, with W'=span(e1). The canonical embedding sends (a,b) to ((a,b),(b,a)), up to nonzero scalars. Its intersection with Ind W' is zero, whereas the image of W' is one-dimensional. Crystalline de Rham comparison preserves this discrepancy. This concretely verifies the algebraic flaw independently of the assessment’s unsupported inference from Borel’s theorem to a p-adic localization isomorphism.
